text:
zoe: Mini panic check 12h before boarding 12: I can't find my passport. Last saw it in the apartment 62d. Anyone had a similar freakout?
manu: Breathe. Check jacket pockets and the weird zipped pouch on your rolling bag. I once left mine in a conference swag tote.
clare: If youre local, sprint back home only if youve got >2 hrs before check-in. Otherwise call the airlines desk; sometimes they let you reschedule without huge fees if you explain.
marta: Bring a copy of your passport photo page + boarding pass on phone as backup for hotel check-in. Also call the consulate ASAP if you're out of country.
ops-bot: Reminder: travel checklist in the shared drive -> Essentials contains passport scan + emergency contacts. https://drive.example/essentials
manu: Pro tip: put a photo of your passport and a selfie with it in a locked note on your phone. Saved my colleague in Lisbon when their wallet was stolen.
zoe: Found it! It slid under the couch where the cat sleeps 602. Thank you for the calm and fast tips.
clare: Yay! Also, PSA: if you have Global Entry/TSA Pre, check that your Known Traveler Number is on the reservation. Saves you a ton of time.
marta: For offsite folks: share arrival ETA in the travel thread so we can coordinate airport pickups. No one should be left waiting 2 hours for a shuttle.
manu: Side note: who wants a tiny luggage duct tape + spare zip ties in the team kit? :thumbsup: / :thumbsdown:
clare: :thumbsup: from me. Also add snack bars.
ops-bot: Noted: "team kit" additions updated in travel checklist.
